It's about %s.
They say a seed was in hand.
I promised to plant it in spring.
One more seed sits
in that small hand.
At court we say a name three times.
%s.
…I cannot say it twice.
%s.
A body no bigger than a leaf.
Why is the empty space so large?
%s 소식 들었습니다.\n요정은 떠난 이를 위해\n도토리 잔을 엎어 둡니:
I heard about %s.
For those who leave, fairies
turn an acorn cup upside down.
A tiny cup lies upturned
on the windowsill.
%s 말이에요.\n큰 분들은 쓰러지는 소리도\n커요. 숲 끝까지 들렸어요:
It's about %s.
When big folk fall, it's loud.
I heard it at the forest's edge.
Wings folded,
silent for a long while.
숲에선 쓰러진 나무 옆에\n새 나무를 심습니다.\n%s 곁에도 심겠습니다:
In the forest, by a fallen tree
we plant a new one.
I will plant one beside %s.
The lodge was moaning.
The beams groaned all night.
I didn't sleep a wink.
To fairy ears,
even a house can hurt.
지붕에 구멍이 났더군요.\n제 몸이면 드나들기 좋지만\n…그래도 막으시는:
There is a hole in the roof.
Perfect for someone my size,
…but you should patch it.
벽이 다친 날엔 궁정에서\n이끼를 보냈습니다.\n여기선 제가 이끼를 붙이:
When walls were hurt, the court
would send moss.
Here, I shall be the moss.
니벨라가 쓰러졌다지요.\n북쪽 나무들이 오늘 아침\n처음으로 숨을 쉬었습:
They say Nivella has fallen.
This morning the northern trees
breathed for the first time.
A people who hear
even the forest breathe.
거미줄이 녹고 있어요!\n이슬 맺힌 줄은 예쁜데,\n그건 하나도 안 예뻤:
The webs are melting!
Dewy webs are pretty,
but those were not pretty at all.
궁정에 알려야겠습니다.\n'북쪽 마녀, 서리 거미를 벰.'\n…짧아서 믿:
I must report to the court.
'North Witch slew frost spider.'
…Too short. They won't believe it.
Those eyes are asking
for a longer version.
어젯밤엔 땅이 계속 울렸어요.\n뿌리들이 다 깼을 거예요.\n저도 깼고요:
The ground shook all last night.
Every root must be awake now.
So am I.
So many came crashing in,
yet the lodge still stands.
Like an old oak.
I hid under my wings.
I'm not ashamed.
…Maybe a little ashamed.
안개는 숲이 쉬는 숨이에요.\n그런데 어젯밤 안개는\n누가 대신 쉰 것:
Fog is the forest's breath.
But last night's fog felt like
someone else was breathing.
Spoken like a riddle,
but the eyes are serious.
In fog the wings get wet
and one cannot fly.
I walked. For a very long time.
안개 낀 밤엔 요정 길이\n열린다는 말이 있어요.\n…어젯밤 건 다른 길:
They say on foggy nights
the fairy roads open.
…Last night it was another road.
이제 밤이 둘도 안 남았지요.\n궁정에선 끝을 세지 않습니다.\n세면 끝:
Not even two nights remain.
At court we never count the end.
Counting draws it closer.
Still, the fingers
are folding down.
When spring comes,
I want to bury a seed here.
So hold on, lodge.
마지막 밤들은 늘 길어요.\n짧은 날개로 버티려면\n…주인님 옆이 제일:
The last nights are always long.
To last on such short wings,
…your side is warmest, Innkeeper.
수프가 맑아서 바닥이 보여요.\n요정은 이슬로도 살지만\n큰 분들은 안:
The soup is so thin I see the bowl.
Fairies can live on dew,
but big folk can't.
Pours from their own share
into someone else's bowl.
고기가 떨어졌다고요?\n괜찮습니다. 도토리를\n…아, 이건 제 겨울 몫이:
Out of meat, you say?
No matter. I have acorns—
…ah, those were my winter store.
The forest knows how to go
hungry in winter. The lodge,
I think, has not learned yet.
Nobody got hurt last night!
So today I'll play just
one prank. Only one.
고요한 밤이었습니다.\n서리가 창에 꽃을 그렸지요.\n궁정 화가보다 낫더:
It was a quiet night.
Frost drew flowers on the glass.
Better than any court painter.
Everyone is safe?
Then I'll crack open a seed
to celebrate.
